units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:1">Shebu. VI, 1</cite> <he>הה׳ בשוה וכ׳</he> the amount admitted to be due must be at least one P’rutah.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3b">B. Mets. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הוֹדָאַת בעל דין וכ׳</he> the admission of indebtedness by the defendant is worth as much as a hundred witnesses; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:10">Sot. IX, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 47a:20">47ᵃ</cite>) <he>הוֹדָיַית המעשר</he> (Mish. <he>הוֹדָיוֹת</he>, pl.) the confession to be recited on having given away the third year’s tithes (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 26:12">Deut. XXVI, 12</cite> sq.); ib. 47ᵇ <cite ref="E00203"><he>הוֹדָאַת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:15">Maas. Sh. V, 15</cite> (Mish. ed. <he>הודיות</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:5">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> Leah seized <he>פלך ה׳</he> the shuttle of confession (made gratitude her duty, <cite ref="Genesis 29:35">Gen. XXIX, 35</cite>); <he>בעלי ה׳</he> men of confession (ready to admit their wrong or to thank the Lord); Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:2">Ber. IV, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:3">28ᵇ</cite>) <he>אני נותן ה׳ וכ׳</he> I offer thanks for my lot (being permitted to teach). Y. ib. I, 3ᵈ top <he>ה׳ ושבח וכ׳</he> thanks and praise are due to &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: Hodaah, the first of the last three sections of the Prayer of Benedictions (תפלה), so named from the words Modim &c.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 34a:14">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>בה׳ תחלה וכ׳</he> in reciting the Hodaah one must bend at the beginning &c.
Ib.ᵇ בה׳ ובה׳ של הלל on reading the Hodaah or the thanksgiving in Hallel (הוֹדוּ).
<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ דבה״מ</he> the thanksgiving in the grace after meal <he>(נוֹדֶה לְךָ וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:13">Y. Taan. II, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הידייה</he>.—Pl. <he>הוֹדָאיֹת</he>, <he>הוֹדָיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Taanit 6b:16">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>ברוך רוב הה׳</he> blessed be He to whom a multitude of thanks is due; <he>אל הה׳</he> the Power to whom (all) thanksgivings are due; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top; a. fr.—
Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ bot. פר של ה׳ the bullock over which the confessions are uttered.—Esp. Hodâaoth, proceedings resting on evidences of the defendant’s admission of his indebtedness.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 2b:3">Snh. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 84b">B. Kam. 84ᵇ</cite>; a. e.; cmp. <cite ref="A00566"><he>אוֹדִיתָא</he></cite>.
